steps.title: Gather materials and reagents
steps.instruction: Collect all required items: pipette tips (BioExpress, catalog P-1236-200; Biotix, catalog P-1236-200CS), 35 mm glass‑bottom dishes (lab‑made), mouse embryonic stem cells and HEK293T cells, Janelia Fluor 549 dye (JF 549, provided by Dr. Luke D. Lavis), Trypsin‑EDTA (Thermo Fisher Gibco™, catalog 25300054, 0.05% solution), PBS (Sigma‑Aldrich, catalog D8537‑500ML), gelatin (Sigma‑Aldrich, catalog G1890‑100G), DMEM (Sigma‑Aldrich, catalog D5796), FluoroBrite DMEM (Thermo Fisher Gibco™, catalog A1896701), fetal bovine serum (Sigma‑Aldrich, catalog F0926), L‑glutamine (Thermo Fisher Gibco™, catalog 25030081), penicillin‑streptomycin (Thermo Fisher Gibco™, catalog 15140122), β‑mercaptoethanol (Thermo Fisher Gibco™, catalog 21985023), non‑essential amino acids (Thermo Fisher, catalog 1114050), leukemia inhibitory factor (LIF, lab‑made).

steps.title: Prepare culture media
steps.instruction: Make ES cell medium by mixing DMEM with 15 % FBS, 2 mM glutamine, 100 U ml⁻¹ penicillin‑streptomycin, 0.1 mM β‑mercaptoethanol, 1 000 U ml⁻¹ LIF, and 0.1 mM non‑essential amino acids; make live‑cell imaging medium by using FluoroBrite DMEM instead of DMEM and adding the same supplements.

steps.title: Coat glass‑bottom dish with gelatin
steps.instruction: Add gelatin (Sigma‑Aldrich, catalog G1890‑100G) to the 35 mm glass‑bottom dish and incubate overnight to create a gelatinized surface.

steps.title: Trypsinize confluent cells
steps.instruction: For cells at 70‑90 % confluence, apply 0.05 % trypsin‑EDTA (1×): use 0.6 ml for a 60 mm plate or 1.5 ml for a 100 mm plate; incubate as recommended to detach cells.

steps.title: Seed cells onto coated dish
steps.instruction: Transfer 20 % of the trypsinized cells onto the gelatin‑coated 35 mm glass‑bottom dish and culture overnight until the culture reaches 80‑90 % confluence.

steps.title: Prepare JF 549 dye solutions
steps.instruction: Dilute JF 549 dye (provided by Dr. Luke D. Lavis) to final concentrations of 5 nM, 15 nM, and 30 nM in appropriate volume of culture medium.

steps.title: Label cells with JF 549
steps.instruction: Incubate the cells with the chosen JF 549 concentration for 15 min at 37 °C in 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Wash cells once with ES medium
steps.instruction: Gently rinse the cells with ES medium a single time to remove excess dye.

steps.title: Incubate in ES medium
steps.instruction: Place the washed cells in fresh ES medium and incubate for 30 min at 37 °C in 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Replace with imaging medium
steps.instruction: Remove ES medium and add live‑cell imaging medium to the dish.

steps.title: Image cells under controlled temperature
steps.instruction: Maintain the dish at 37 °C using a heater controller; image each plate within a maximum of 1.5 h after placement on the microscope, aiming for 10‑50 fluorescent spots per nucleus (adjust dye concentration if needed).

steps.title: Process imaging data
steps.instruction: Upload acquired movies to u‑track 2.0, crop each individual cell from the larger movie, and process the cropped movies as described in Note 6.
